description: AI Tutor Chat - Conversational learning interface using RAG over the formula database and question bank. Users can ask questions like 'Explain modified duration like I'm 5' or 'What's the difference between NPV and IRR?' and get contextual answers grounded in the CFA curriculum. Integrates with existing AI provider infrastructure.
steps: Create src/features/ai-tutor/ directory with types/, utils/, components/, and __tests__/ subdirectories

Create src/features/ai-tutor/types/index.ts with interfaces: ChatMessage (id, role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system', content, timestamp, sources?: SourceReference[]), ChatSession (id, messages, topic?, createdAt, updatedAt), SourceReference (type: 'formula' | 'question' | 'concept', id, title, relevanceScore), TutorConfig (maxHistoryLength, contextWindowSize, systemPromptOverride?)

Create src/features/ai-tutor/utils/context-retriever.ts implementing: (1) findRelevantFormulas(query) - searches formulaSeed by keyword matching on name, topic, variables, keyTip returning top-5 relevant formulas, (2) findRelevantQuestions(query) - searches questions by topic/text matching, (3) buildContext(query, formulas, questions) - assembles RAG context for the AI prompt

Create src/features/ai-tutor/utils/chat-prompt-builder.ts that builds the system prompt including: CFA tutor persona, retrieved context (formulas/questions), conversation history, and instructions to cite sources. Follow pattern from src/features/ai-explanations/utils/build-prompt.ts
Create src/features/ai-tutor/utils/chat-storage.ts to persist chat sessions in localStorage (key: 'cfa-buddy-tutor-sessions'), with session management (create, list, delete, get active)

Create src/features/ai-tutor/components/chat-interface.tsx - the main chat UI component with: (1) message list with user/assistant styling, (2) input field with submit button, (3) suggested questions for new users, (4) source citations displayed inline, (5) loading state during AI response. Uses Navy/Gold/Green theme. Client component with streaming support indication.
Create src/features/ai-tutor/components/suggested-questions.tsx - renders a grid of starter questions like 'Explain DuPont analysis', 'What is convexity?', 'How does LIFO vs FIFO affect taxes?'
Create src/features/ai-tutor/components/source-citation.tsx - renders formula/question source references as clickable badges below AI messages

Create src/app/api/tutor/route.ts - API route that receives chat messages, calls context retriever to build RAG context, calls AI provider (following pattern in src/app/api/explain/), streams response back. Returns graceful error if no AI key configured.

Create src/features/ai-tutor/__tests__/context-retriever.test.ts testing: (1) finds relevant formulas by topic keyword, (2) finds relevant questions by subject, (3) returns empty when no matches, (4) limits results to top-5, (5) ranks by relevance

Create src/features/ai-tutor/__tests__/chat-prompt-builder.test.ts testing: (1) includes system persona, (2) includes retrieved context, (3) truncates long history, (4) escapes special characters in user input
Add route page at src/app/(protected)/learn/tutor/page.tsx rendering the chat interface
Add 'AI Tutor' link in navigation under the Learn section with a MessageCircle or Sparkles icon
